description: This Java class implements a helper service for managing delinquency actions related to loans, specifically calculating effective pause periods and computing paused days before or within specific ranges.

classes.name: DelinquencyEffectivePauseHelperImpl
classes.description: Implementation of helper methods for calculating delinquency pause periods and durations.

methods.name: calculateEffectiveDelinquencyList
methods.description: Calculates effective delinquency periods by pairing pause and resume actions.

methods.name: getPausedDaysBeforeDate
methods.description: Calculates total paused days before a given date based on effective delinquency list.

methods.name: getPausedDaysWithinRange
methods.description: Calculates the total paused days within a specific date range.

methods.name: findMatchingResume
methods.description: Finds a resume action that matches a given pause within a list of resumes.
